title: Global registry aggregation lacks per-project timeout and concurrency limits
description: Evidence: global status maps all registry entries through globalStatusProjectRow, registry doctor inspects entries serially, and global dashboard Promise.all reads/doctor/searches each project without per-project timeouts. Impact: one stale network mount or slow project can stall global status/dashboard, and large registries can fan out unbounded work.
acceptanceCriteria: Global project probes use bounded per-project timeouts and a configurable concurrency limit.
Timed-out projects return structured findings while healthy projects still render.
